# biznetgio_baremetal_openvpn (Data Source)

Konfigurasi OpenVPN akses OOB ke bare-metal (`GET /baremetals/openvpn`, scope seluruh customer).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_baremetal_openvpn" "main" {}

output "openvpn_config" {
  value     = data.biznetgio_baremetal_openvpn.main.config
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `config` (String, Sensitive) Konten config OpenVPN kalau ada di response (alias config/config_file/ovpn/content).
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response.
